_comment: Audit of every mobile source graphic that the Wear OS watch face derives from. Traced from SecretWallpaperService.CSPRenderer.loadImages() and drawObjects(), not from filenames. Read-only input to tools/wear_assets/generate.py.

policy.note: The *_lq.* siblings are the mobile low-memory tier resolved at runtime by SecretWallpaperService.resolveTextureId(). Wear derivatives always come from the full-resolution master.
policy.framing: Every derivative is cropped to the region the 1:1 centre crop of the phone view actually frames, and emitted at exactly the pixel size it is drawn at. tools/wear_assets/framing.py holds the projection; nothing is hand-sized.

assets.renderer_role: Daytime sky quad, drawn first at z=-30, translate(-1.5+skyShift, -2.3), scale(2.0, 2.0). Vertical gradient, deep blue at top to white haze at the horizon.
assets.movement: Horizontal parallax only (skyParallaxShift from the launcher page offset).
assets.procedural: Superseded by SkyGradientTexture when the dynamic sky setting is on.
assets.wear_strategy: Crop the upper band the GL camera actually frames and resize to the full 450x450 face as an opaque background.

assets.renderer_role: Night sky quad for the clear and cloudy families; the star band is baked into its upper region.
assets.procedural: Superseded by SkyGradientTexture plus StarFieldTexture when the dynamic sky setting is on.
assets.wear_strategy: Same crop as the day sky so the horizon line matches between day and night.

assets.renderer_role: Overcast daytime sky, used by the fog, rain, snow, sleet, dreary and thunderstorm scenes.
assets.wear_strategy: Same crop rectangle as the clear sky.

assets.renderer_role: Overcast night sky for the rain, snow, sleet, dreary and thunderstorm scenes.
assets.wear_strategy: Same crop rectangle as the clear sky.

assets.renderer_role: Darkening wash drawn over the sky quad at night for D3/D4/D5/D6/D9, using the same transform as the sky.
assets.alpha: drawn at alpha 1.0; its own gradient carries the falloff
assets.wear_strategy: Rotated to landscape, cropped to the framed band and resized to 450x450 as a translucent overlay.

assets.renderer_role: Legacy star band drawn at translate(1.3+skyShift, 7.0, -29.9) scale(1.8, 0.45) on clear nights and during twilight.
assets.procedural: Superseded by the generated StarField on the mobile dynamic-sky path.
assets.wear_strategy: Crop the densest span of the band, stretch it across the upper sky and fade the lower edge so the band ends before the horizon.

assets.renderer_role: Single twinkling star sprite drawn seven times at fixed x_star/y_star positions with an alpha ramp on a 200-frame cycle.
assets.procedural: yes, the alpha ramp is computed per frame
assets.wear_strategy: One trimmed sprite reused by three PartImage instances whose alpha is driven by a triangle-wave Transform.

assets.renderer_role: Shooting star that drifts down and left, shrinking and fading, restarted every 200 frames.
assets.movement: translate plus scale plus alpha decay per frame
assets.alpha: 1.0 decaying by a factor of 0.9 per frame
assets.wear_strategy: Not reproduced.

assets.renderer_role: Outer flare corona, rotates at +0.54 degrees per frame around the sun position.
assets.wear_strategy: Composited with a_sun_03 into a single rotating ray sprite so one texture carries both corona passes.

assets.renderer_role: Bright core disc, rotates at +0.36 degrees per frame.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed to its own bounds and drawn as the static sun core.

assets.renderer_role: Counter-rotating corona, -0.54 degrees per frame.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into sun_rays with a_sun_01; the counter-rotation is collapsed into one direction.

assets.renderer_role: Lens-flare streak, projected onto the flare plane and played on a 200-frame swell whenever a clear scene is entered.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed to the region the crop actually frames and drawn as a static streak under the sun at low alpha. The mobile renderer plays it as a one-shot swell on scene entry, which WFF cannot trigger, but at this framing the flare crosses the face and is a signature part of the look, so it is kept as a constant element.

assets.renderer_role: New moon, moonResouceID indices 0 and 26.
assets.movement: Static at (3.2, 7.0, -28.5) scale 0.3, or arced when the automatic moon path is on.
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged. moon_00.png is fully transparent in the mobile artwork, which is how the renderer makes the new moon invisible; the Wear face reproduces that by holding the moon group at alpha 0 when [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] is 0, so no degenerate empty resource is shipped.

assets.renderer_role: Evening crescent, moonResouceID indices 1 to 4.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 1.

assets.renderer_role: First quarter, moonResouceID indices 5 to 8.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 2.

assets.renderer_role: Waxing gibbous, moonResouceID indices 9 to 12.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 3.

assets.renderer_role: Full moon, moonResouceID index 13.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 4. Also the moon used in the packaged preview drawable.

assets.renderer_role: Waning gibbous, moonResouceID indices 14 to 17.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 5.

assets.renderer_role: Last quarter, moonResouceID indices 18 to 21.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 6.

assets.renderer_role: Morning crescent, moonResouceID indices 22 to 25.
assets.wear_strategy: Selected by [MOON_PHASE_TYPE] equal to 7.

assets.renderer_role: Light daytime cumulus, cloud1 slot for the mostly-clear scene only.
assets.movement: x drifts by -0.025 world units per frame and wraps over cloudWrapSpan
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed cumulus sprite drifting across the sky under a time-driven Transform.

assets.renderer_role: Daytime overcast bank, cloud1 slot for the cloudy, ice-cold, rain, snow, sleet and thunderstorm scenes.
assets.movement: same drift and wrap as cloud_a_01, drawn seven times at different y, scale and alpha
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed sprite, two drifting instances at different depths.

assets.renderer_role: Heavy grey bank, cloud1 slot for dreary and fog by day and for mostly-clear by night.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed sprite used for the overcast day bank and the mostly-clear night bank.

assets.renderer_role: Night bank, cloud1 slot for cloudy, rain, snow, sleet and thunderstorm nights.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed sprite for all night cloud passes.

assets.renderer_role: cloud2 slot partner of cloud_a_01 for the mostly-clear day scene.
assets.movement: same drift and wrap on an independent offset
assets.wear_strategy: Second drifting cumulus sprite.

assets.renderer_role: cloud2 slot partner of cloud_a_02.
assets.wear_strategy: Second drifting bank sprite.

assets.renderer_role: cloud2 slot partner of cloud_a_03.
assets.wear_strategy: Second overcast and night sprite.

assets.renderer_role: cloud2 slot partner of cloud_a_04.
assets.wear_strategy: Second night sprite.

assets.renderer_role: In-cloud flash overlay for the thunderstorm scene, drawn at the cloud_A positions on a 400-frame schedule.
assets.alpha: random 0.6 to 1.0 rising then 0.0 to 0.4 falling
assets.wear_strategy: The discrete in-cloud sprites are merged into a single alpha-pulsed cloud glow.

assets.renderer_role: Second in-cloud flash variant.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into storm_cloud_glow.

assets.renderer_role: Third in-cloud flash variant.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into storm_cloud_glow.

assets.renderer_role: In-cloud flash overlay for the cloud_B positions.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into storm_cloud_glow.

assets.renderer_role: Second cloud_B flash variant.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into storm_cloud_glow.

assets.renderer_role: Third cloud_B flash variant.
assets.wear_strategy: Merged into storm_cloud_glow.

assets.renderer_role: Full-screen white flash at translate(7.0, 0.0, -19.0), four frames up then four frames down inside each thunder event.
assets.alpha: 0.0 to peak to 0.0 over eight frames
assets.wear_strategy: Rotated to landscape, cropped and resized to a full-face wash whose alpha is a sawtooth pulse.

assets.renderer_role: Bolt variant 0, drawn at a random position and scale during a thunder event.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed bolt sprite whose alpha is pulsed on a fixed schedule.

assets.renderer_role: Bolt variant 1.
assets.wear_strategy: Second trimmed bolt sprite on an offset schedule.

assets.renderer_role: Bolt variant 2.
assets.wear_strategy: Third trimmed bolt sprite on an offset schedule.

assets.renderer_role: Full-screen rain sheet, frame 0 of a three-frame cycle chosen by mFrameCnt modulo 3, at z=-20.5 scale(0.75, 1.9).
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped to the window the 1:1 centre crop frames and emitted as frame 0 of a three-frame SequenceImages at 12 fps, which is the mobile renderer's own flicker cycle. Alpha is multiplied by 6 because the source peaks at 21/255 and relied on premultiplied additive blending.

assets.renderer_role: Frame 1 of the rain cycle.
assets.wear_strategy: Frame 1 of the same three-frame sequence; see c_rain_01.png.

assets.renderer_role: Frame 2 of the rain cycle.
assets.wear_strategy: Frame 2 of the same three-frame sequence; see c_rain_01.png.

assets.renderer_role: Static lens-water overlay at z=-20 drawn above the rain sheet for rain, sleet and, unless suppressed, thunderstorms, and for the legacy high-humidity overlay.
assets.wear_strategy: Rotated to landscape, cropped and resized to a full-face overlay held at low alpha so it reads as beading rather than smearing the small display.

assets.renderer_role: Large near flake, five instances, rotating at 0.225 degrees per frame and falling until y is less than -8.
assets.movement: fall and rotate, respawn at the top
assets.wear_strategy: Scattered into the near seamless snow strip.

assets.renderer_role: Mid flake, seventy instances.
assets.wear_strategy: Scattered into both snow strips.

assets.renderer_role: Small far flake, one hundred and fifty instances.
assets.wear_strategy: Scattered into the far seamless snow strip.

assets.renderer_role: Heavy-snow puff drawn beside every 273rd mid flake when the many-snows setting is on.
assets.wear_strategy: Scattered sparsely into the near snow strip so heavy snow keeps its soft clumps.

assets.renderer_role: Ice fringe at z=-20.3 sized to just over the screen, drawn for snow, sleet, freezing fog and the below-freezing overlay.
assets.wear_strategy: Rotated to landscape, cropped and resized to a full-face fringe, then masked to the round bezel so the ice stays at the rim.

assets.renderer_role: Daytime fog wash at z=-20, drawn at alpha 0.4.
assets.wear_strategy: Rotated to landscape and tiled into a horizontally seamless 900x450 strip that drifts sideways, giving the wisps motion the mobile scene never had.

assets.renderer_role: Night fog wash at z=-20, drawn at alpha 0.9.
assets.wear_strategy: Same seamless drifting strip treatment as fog_01.

assets.renderer_role: Near hill at z=-23, translate(x from groundParallaxOffset times 1.2, -6.4) scale(3.5, 3.2). Green summer hill.
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped to the hill silhouette and resized to a 560-wide near band so gyro parallax never exposes an edge.

assets.renderer_role: Far hill at z=-24, scale(3.6, 1.8), parallax weight 0.5.
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as land_far_day.

assets.renderer_role: Near hill at night for every scene except snow and sleet.
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped and resized to the near band for the shared night ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Far hill at night, partner of a_land_03.
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as land_far_night.

assets.renderer_role: Near hill under overcast daylight for the cloudy, fog, ice-cold, dreary and thunderstorm scenes.
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped and resized to the near band for the overcast day ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Snow-covered near hill by day for the snow and sleet scenes.
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped and resized to the near band for the snow day ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Snow-covered far hill by day.
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as land_far_snow_day.

assets.renderer_role: Snow-covered near hill at night.
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped and resized to the near band for the snow night ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Snow-covered far hill at night.
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as land_far_snow_night.

assets.renderer_role: Foreground grass tufts at z=-23 with the depth test disabled, drawn after the near hill.
assets.movement: shares the near hill parallax weight
assets.wear_strategy: Cropped and resized to a 560-wide foreground band pinned to the bottom of the face.

assets.renderer_role: Night grass tufts.
assets.movement: shares the near hill parallax weight
assets.wear_strategy: Foreground band for the night ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Overcast daytime grass tufts.
assets.movement: shares the near hill parallax weight
assets.wear_strategy: Foreground band for the overcast day ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Snowy daytime foreground.
assets.movement: shares the near hill parallax weight
assets.wear_strategy: Foreground band for the snow day ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Snowy night foreground.
assets.movement: shares the near hill parallax weight
assets.wear_strategy: Foreground band for the snow night ground set.

assets.renderer_role: Three-blade rotor for the nearest windmill row (distance 0), rotated by mWindmillAngle plus a per-mill offset.
assets.movement: continuous rotation whose speed follows the reported wind speed
assets.alpha: windmill_alpha 0.8 to 1.0; RGB multiplied by 0.2 at night
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed to its own bounds so rotation happens about the true hub, emitted in a lit, a night-dimmed and an ambient-silhouette variant.

assets.renderer_role: Motion-blurred rotor for the mid and far windmill rows (distances 1 and 2).
assets.alpha: windmill_alpha; RGB multiplied by 0.2 at night
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as wm_rotor_blur_day, wm_rotor_blur_night.

assets.renderer_role: Nacelle hub cap drawn over the rotor for distance-0 mills only.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed hub sprite in lit and night variants.

assets.renderer_role: Tower for distance-0 mills whose flip flag is false.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed tower in lit, night and ambient-silhouette variants.

assets.renderer_role: Mirrored tower for distance-0 mills whose flip flag is true, so the cluster does not look cloned.
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged. Both mills that fall inside the crop (indices 1 and 2) have windmill_flip false, so the mirrored tower is never needed.

assets.renderer_role: Soft tower for distance 1 and 2 mills.
assets.wear_strategy: Packaged: emitted at the exact drawn size for the 1:1 centre crop as wm_tower_far_day, wm_tower_far_night.

assets.renderer_role: Mirrored soft tower for flipped distance 1 and 2 mills.
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged; the distance 1 and 2 mill rows are outside the crop.

assets.renderer_role: Current watermark drawn bottom-left when the logo setting is on. The texture has about 25px of transparent left padding out of 512.
assets.wear_strategy: Trimmed and downscaled to a small bottom-centre watermark behind an opt-in BooleanConfiguration.

assets.renderer_role: Classic watermark used when the legacy classic-watermark setting is on.
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged. One watermark is enough on a 450px face; documented as a known difference.

assets.renderer_role: Twenty-five-frame run-off animation, instance set 1, played on randomised start frames over the waterdrop overlay.
assets.movement: frame sequence at a fixed position
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged. Fifty frames of 256x512 would dominate the memory budget for an effect that is a few pixels tall at 450px. Documented as a known difference.

assets.renderer_role: Twenty-five-frame run-off animation, instance set 2.
assets.movement: frame sequence at a fixed position
assets.wear_strategy: Not packaged, as above.
